label: SI-7(1)
title: Integrity Checks

statement.prose: Perform an integrity check of {{ insert: param, si-7.1_prm_1 }} {{ insert: param, si-7.1_prm_2 }}.

guidance: Security-relevant events include the identification of new threats to which organizational systems are susceptible and the installation of new hardware, software, or firmware. Transitional states include system startup, restart, shutdown, and abort.

params.label: organization-defined transitional states or security-relevant events
software
guidelines: software on which an integrity check is to be performed is defined;

params.label: transitional states or security-relevant events
guidelines: transitional states or security-relevant events requiring integrity checks (on software) are defined (if selected);

params.label: frequency
guidelines: frequency with which to perform an integrity check (on software) is defined (if selected);

params.label: firmware
guidelines: firmware on which an integrity check is to be performed is defined;

params.label: transitional states or security-relevant events
guidelines: transitional states or security-relevant events requiring integrity checks (on firmware) are defined (if selected);

params.label: frequency
guidelines: frequency with which to perform an integrity check (on firmware) is defined (if selected);

params.label: transitional states or security-relevant events
guidelines: transitional states or security-relevant events requiring integrity checks (of information) are defined (if selected);
